sources.title: Qwen 3.6: 35B vs 27B comparison - benchmark results
sources.snippet: I finally summed up all the Qwen 3.6 model test results I gathered over the past few days. I compared two models in detail: the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (MoE, hybrid attention/delta) and the Qwen3.6-27B (dense, hybrid attention/delta). I ran both with turbo3 KV cache compression on an RTX 4090 as a llama.cpp server. If I had to summarize briefly: the 35B-A3B is 3-4x faster in everything, but the 27B ...

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-27B is now live on Qwen Studio, available through our API, and released as open weights for the community. Qwen3.6-27B is a fully open-source dense model (27B parameters), featuring: flagship-level agentic coding that surpasses Qwen3.5-397B-A17B strong text and multimodal reasoning ability
